clue.text: Pepper supplier's headgear thus assumed with hesitation

parts.note: a cap is a piece of headgear
sic is Latin for thus, used to flag a quoted error
um is the sound of someone hesitating

explanation.surface: A pepper grower nervously puts on a hat before speaking.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after 'supplier' stands for 'is', linking definition and wordplay; 'assumed with' just strings the pieces together.
explanation.definitionFit: The capsicum is the plant genus that yields sweet peppers and chillies, so it supplies pepper.

clue.text: Agreeing to make amends

definitions.meaning: agreeing with someone is being in harmony
to make amends is to make up for a wrong, to expiate it

explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it means in agreement; as one word it is the verb for making reparation.

clue.text: Press boss supports stenography, being understaffed

indicators.note: in a down clue the piece that supports another sits beneath it, so it comes after

parts.note: stenography is writing in shorthand
the boss of a newspaper is its editor, abbreviated ED

explanation.surface: A newspaper editor backs secretarial skills while the office runs short of staff.
explanation.definitionFit: Being short of hands, that is workers, means having too few staff for the job.

clue.text: Crack parson found on a vessel in church

indicators.note: in places the parson-and-vessel pieces inside the church abbreviation

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
Rev, short for Reverend, is a parson's title
SS is a steamship, a vessel

explanation.surface: A clergyman discovered aboard a ship in a church building.
explanation.definitionFit: A crevasse is a deep crack or fissure, especially in a glacier.

clue.text: Giant American detective, one with grave responsibilities?

parts.note: giant, as an adjective, means monumental or enormous
Perry Mason is the American lawyer-detective of novels and television

explanation.surface: A huge American sleuth who also has serious duties.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grave responsibilities' sounds like weighty duties, but the grave is a burial place: this tradesman carves headstones.
explanation.definitionFit: A monumental mason makes and engraves headstones, so his work is literally on graves.

clue.text: Place and time for a stripper?

parts.note: locus is Latin for place, used in English for a position

explanation.surface: A question about where and when an exotic dancer performs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stripper' suggests a striptease artist, but a swarm of these insects strips crops bare.
explanation.definitionFit: Swarms of locusts strip fields of vegetation, so the insect is whimsically a stripper.

clue.text: Unimaginative son leaves for shower

indicators.note: leaves means the son goes away, so its letter drops from the start

parts.note: slavish means copying without originality, unimaginative

explanation.surface: A dull son walks out and goes off to take a shower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shower' looks like a noun for washing, but it is the verb: to shower gifts on someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To lavish gifts on someone is to shower them generously; both are verbs of bestowing freely.

clue.text: Eccentric running into Great Ouse?

definitions.meaning: an eccentric is an off-centre wheel in machinery, also called by this short name
the river through Cambridge flows into the Great Ouse, an English river in East Anglia

explanation.definitionFit: A cam is an eccentric rotating part in engines, and the Cam is the Cambridge river feeding the Great Ouse.

clue.text: Problem initially encountered in brand-new plant?

indicators.note: in places the initial letter inside the brand-and-new pieces, after their first letter

parts.note: to brand is to sear, and new is mint, as in mint condition

indicators.note: initially means only the first letter of problem is taken

explanation.surface: A difficulty arises at the outset in a freshly launched product.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brand-new' reads as one adjective but splits into brand (SEAR) and new (MINT); the P goes after the S.
explanation.definitionFit: Spearmint is a common garden mint, a plant; the question mark marks it as one example.

clue.text: Old inspector going about in gloomy mood

indicators.note: going about means the inspector's name surrounds the abbreviation for old

parts.note: Inspector Morse is the Oxford detective of novels and the British TV series

explanation.surface: A retired police inspector walks around feeling depressed.
explanation.definitionFit: Morose describes a sullen, gloomy temperament, so someone morose is in a gloomy mood.

clue.text: New award presented in past thirty days

indicators.note: presented in puts the award inside the word for past

parts.note: over means past, as in the danger is over
MBE, Member of the Order of the British Empire, is a British honour

explanation.surface: Someone received a fresh honour within the last month.
explanation.definitionFit: The eleventh month has thirty days, so the phrase can stand for it cryptically.

clue.text: Pressure an old PM endlessly encountered

indicators.note: endlessly means the last letter of the prime minister's name is cut off

parts.note: Edward Heath was British Prime Minister from 1970 to 1974

explanation.surface: A former prime minister came under pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: Heat in the sense of intense pressure or scrutiny, as in the heat is on.

clue.text: Spirit of Greek island quietly moving in this place

indicators.note: moving means the soft-music letter shifts from the front of the island to its end

parts.note: Patmos is a Greek island in the Dodecanese
P, piano, is the musical direction for quietly
here means in this place

explanation.surface: The soul of a Greek island stirs gently on the spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' takes the P from the front of PATMOS to the end, giving ATMOSP.
explanation.definitionFit: The atmosphere of a place is its prevailing spirit or mood.

clue.text: Racing official — dexterous Greek character, some say

indicators.note: some say means the pieces are judged by how they are spoken

parts.note: dexterous means handy, skilful with the hands; kappa is the tenth letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A skilful Greek man who officiates at the races, reportedly.
explanation.definitionFit: A handicapper assigns weights to horses in handicap races, an official role in racing.

clue.text: Booth with two hoofed mammals in?

indicators.note: two hoofed mammals means the animal word is written twice

parts.note: an ass is a hoofed mammal, the donkey
taken as written

explanation.surface: A stall with a pair of donkeys inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Booth' looks like a stall or kiosk; it is John Wilkes Booth, who killed Abraham Lincoln.
explanation.definitionFit: John Wilkes Booth shot President Lincoln in 1865, so he is the archetypal assassin.

clue.text: Sign of grace master can freely provide

indicators.note: freely means the letters of the two words are rearranged at will

explanation.surface: A master is able to grant a sign of divine grace without charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'freely' rearranges MASTER CAN; 'provide' links fodder to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Christian theology defines a sacrament as an outward and visible sign of inward grace.

clue.text: Fasten most of tropical climber back

indicators.note: back means the shortened climber is read in reverse
most of means the final letter of the climber is dropped

parts.note: a liana is a woody climbing vine of tropical forests

explanation.surface: Secure most of a jungle vine behind you.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' trims LIANA to LIAN, which 'back' turns round.
explanation.definitionFit: To nail something is to fasten it with nails.

clue.text: French resort, one with pub outside luxury hotel

indicators.note: outside means the pub word surrounds the numeral one

parts.note: a bar is a pub
I is the Roman numeral for one
the Ritz is a famous luxury hotel in London and Paris

explanation.surface: A French holiday town with a pub outside a grand hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: Biarritz is a seaside resort on the Basque coast of south-west France.

clue.text: Missile giving squadron leader something to chew over

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of squadron

parts.note: cud is what cattle chew over again

explanation.surface: A missile gives a squadron commander food for thought.
explanation.walkthrough: 'squadron leader' looks like the RAF rank, but only gives the letter S.
explanation.definitionFit: The Scud is a Soviet-designed ballistic missile, famous from the Gulf War.

clue.text: Sound girl films pagans

indicators.note: Sound means the pieces are judged by how they are spoken

parts.note: Annie is a girl's name; films, as layers covering glass, are mists

explanation.surface: Healthy girl's movies feature heathens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like an adjective meaning healthy; it signals a soundalike. 'films' is a noun for coatings, not movies.
explanation.definitionFit: Animists believe spirits dwell in natural things, a belief counted as pagan.

clue.text: Bang on, Stanley —- perhaps!

parts.note: re means on or concerning
Port Stanley is the capital of the Falkland Islands, so Stanley is a port

explanation.surface: Exactly right, Stanley, maybe!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bang on' reads as exactly right, but splits: 'Bang' is the definition and 'on' gives RE; 'perhaps' marks Stanley as an example of a port.
explanation.definitionFit: A report is the loud noise of a gun or explosion, a bang.

clue.text: Visionary armed ready for manoeuvres

indicators.note: for manoeuvres means the letters are moved about like troops on exercise

explanation.surface: A dreamer, armed and prepared for military exercises.
explanation.definitionFit: A daydreamer lives in fantasies, as a visionary does in impractical ideals.

clue.text: River featuring in popular novel

indicators.note: featuring in means the answer appears within the run of these words

explanation.surface: A river appears in a bestselling book.
explanation.definitionFit: The Arno is the river flowing through Florence and Pisa in Italy.

clue.text: Dark period when man on board abandons head

indicators.note: abandons head means the first letter of the chess piece is lost

parts.note: a knight is a chess piece, a man on the board

explanation.surface: Darkness falls when a ship's passenger loses his head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'man on board' suggests a ship; it is a chessman.
explanation.definitionFit: Night is the period of darkness between sunset and sunrise.

clue.text: Spiteful goddess seizing leader of occupied state

indicators.note: seizing means the goddess's name holds the other letters inside

parts.note: Venus is the Roman goddess of love

indicators.note: leader of means the first letter of occupied

parts.note: MO is the postal abbreviation for Missouri, a US state

explanation.surface: A vicious goddess captures the ruler of an occupied country.
explanation.definitionFit: Venomous literally means poisonous, and figuratively spiteful or malicious.

clue.text: Poem that's outstanding when read aloud

indicators.note: when read aloud means the word is judged by how it is spoken

parts.note: outstanding, of a debt, means still owed

explanation.surface: A poem that is excellent when recited.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outstanding' looks like praise, but means unpaid.
explanation.definitionFit: An ode is a lyric poem, often addressed to a subject.

clue.text: Challenge male boxer breaking into home

indicators.note: breaking into means the male and boxer pieces go inside the word for home

parts.note: in means at home
pug is short for pugilist, a boxer

explanation.surface: A male fighter burgles a house, inviting a challenge.
explanation.definitionFit: To impugn is to challenge the truth or honesty of something.

clue.text: Confirm whereabouts of top cricketers

definitions.meaning: to confirm is to bear witness, to vouch for
the best cricketers are found at a Test, the top international match

explanation.definitionFit: To attest is to confirm or certify; as two words it is where Test players are.

clue.text: Article about unknown ceremony involving a Jewish ascetic

indicators.note: about means the article is turned around

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
Z is a mathematical unknown
a rite is a ceremony

explanation.surface: A piece on a mysterious ritual including a Jewish holy man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involving' links the ceremony to the A beside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A Nazarite took a vow of separation in ancient Israel, abstaining from wine and haircuts.
